svg.title: LM7 layered compiler and hardware architecture
svg.desc: A PyTorch model flows through LM7 orchestration, then through hardware-specific compiler backends and runtime lowering layers to CPU, GPU, TPU, Tenstorrent, and Qualcomm hardware.
svg.metadata: Brand marks are adapted from Simple Icons 16.1.0; the TPU product icon comes from the official Google Cloud icon library.
svg.text: one model · multiple compiler stacks · local hardware
J+A = backend supports both compile-time and export-time lowering. Detailed support remains in the backend table.
